client.business_model: Multi-site women’s healthcare provider integrating brick-and-mortar clinics with telehealth and other ancillary services
client.sponsor_pe_firm: BlueMountain Capital Management (major investor, 2020); Deerfield Management (earlier growth investor)
client.client_history: Founded in 2014 by Sean Glass and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, Advantia Health has expanded through acquisitions such as Heartland Women’s Healthcare (2019) and the Pacify telehealth platform to become a multi-state network offering OB/GYN, maternal-fetal medicine, urgent care and virtual care services.

revenue.source: Zippia ($13M, 2025); Buzzfile ($29.1M, accessed 2026-01-26); Growjo ($22.4M, accessed 2026-01-26); CanvasBusinessModel.com ($89M, 2024)
revenue.notes: All available figures are third-party estimates that vary widely ($13M–$89M) with no confirmation from company filings or press releases, so revenue could not be reliably verified.

locations.source: Company locations list on AdvantiaHealth.com (accessed 2026-01-26) combined with PRNewswire release (Feb 2019) stating 25 Heartland sites
locations.notes: Heartland acquisition added 25 sites; counting unique facility bullets across MD, VA, DC, IL and MO pages on the current locations list yields ~46. Exact number may fluctuate with openings/closures.

employees.source: LinkedIn company page (≈500 employees as of Jan 2026); LeadIQ (501, Dec 2025); Indeed (501-1,000 range, accessed 2026-01-26)
employees.notes: Most recent LinkedIn and LeadIQ figures converge around 500 employees, while other sources provide broad ranges.

extraction_sources: Agreement/Advantia Treya Procurement Cost Reduction Services Agreement (Dec 13 2021) – page 1
Assessment/AdvantiaHealth - Spend Analysis Opportunity v1 JV (11-22-2021).pptx
PRNewswire: Advantia Health expands nationally with acquisition of Heartland Women’s Healthcare (Feb 2019)
extraction_notes: Company name verified in signed services agreement and multiple presentation decks as "Advantia Health".
BlueMountain Capital Management’s $45 M investment (Jan 2020 press release) and Deerfield Management’s 2016 growth round both cited on Advantia’s news pages; treated as PE sponsorship.
Revenue figures are all from estimation websites with large discrepancies and no corroboration from primary sources; therefore revenue left null with low confidence.
Location count derived by combining the 25 sites added via the 2019 Heartland acquisition and current clinic listings across five states; company does not publish an exact number.
No EBITDA figures located in documents, press releases, or reputable databases.
